name: Rise Against!!
source:
Rachael [renameable] is a quirky girl in year 11 (Second last year of high school). Recently transferred to an all girls school due to it's expansive subject selection pool, she miraculously made friends with a nice group of girls after contemplating a life of lonership when no one talked to her for 2 periods. There's just something about that popular girl in her group though...and that (cute) guy on her train.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=22439]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
瑞秋（可改名）是个古灵精怪的女孩，正在读十一年级，也就是高中的倒数第二年。最近，她因为一所女校提供的丰富选课范围而转学过去。连续两节课都没人跟她说话后，她一度打算就这样孤独地度过校园生活，后来却奇迹般地结交了一群友善的女孩。不过，朋友群里那个受欢迎的女孩似乎有些特别…还有她坐火车时遇见的那个可爱男孩。

（摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=22439]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]）
